issue: péruti mr̥yéto: imperfect (PST mid) for a single past event 'he died last year'; the aorist mért exists (rule 8). Otherwise matches.
dh₃ént (AOR 3pl) 'gave' for 'What do your people give?' and dh₃mé / sikʷmé (AOR 1pl) for 'we give ... we pour': aorist for a habitual present (rule 8 PRS = habitual).
ḱlutā́m in 'Have you heard my name in songs?' is the aorist 3DU (or fem. acc. participle), not 2SG 'you heard'; needs ḱlúwes/2sg aorist (answer ḱlḗm 1SG is right).
wikḗte is SBJV 2PL 'you (pl) shall fight', but the oath is 'I will not fight against you' (1SG).
kénkoh₂ is PRS 1SG 'I am hungry' with subject wĺ̥kʷōs (nom. pl.) 'the wolves are hungry too'; needs 3PL kénkonti.
Addressee number shifts inside one turn: gʷʰédʰyete and gʷr̥nHté are 2PL (the group asking 'shall we'), but dh₃dʰí 'give him a yearling and mead' is 2SG; should be 2PL (dh₃té).
ne mért (aorist) for 'she does not die': gnomic aorist, acceptable.

kʷéḱetes is SBJV 2DU/3DU, but 'Will I see the wind?' needs 1SG (kʷéḱoh₂).
h₁áyto/h₁áyn̥to aorist-only middle 'receive' in a gnomic present: acceptable.
